methodology.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on training data
methodology.evaluation_principle: Compare baseline, neural-network, optimization, and regularization approaches

regression.expected_outcome: Deep neural networks should demonstrate nonlinear modeling capability compared with the single-neuron baseline.

classification.expected_outcome: The classifier should achieve strong validation performance while using EarlyStopping to reduce unnecessary overfitting.

regularization.expected_outcome: Regularization effectiveness is dataset-dependent; Dropout may outperform the combined configuration on small structured datasets.

data_leakage.note: Scalers are fitted on training data and applied to validation data.

reproducibility.note: A fixed random state and TensorFlow seed are defined.

early_stopping.note: EarlyStopping with restore_best_weights is used in relevant experiments.

model_comparison.note: Multiple architectures and regularization strategies are compared.

metrics.note: Regression and classification use task-appropriate metrics.

independent_test_set.note: The notebook primarily uses train-validation evaluation rather than a separate held-out test set.

limitations: The datasets are small and come from scikit-learn.
Results depend on a single train-validation split.
No independent held-out test set is used.
The project focuses on educational deep-learning fundamentals rather than production deployment.
No external benchmark or cross-validation study is included.

portfolio_assessment.overall_positioning: hands-on deep learning fundamentals and experimental machine learning project

recommended_next_steps: Add automated notebook execution in CI.
Add a dedicated held-out test set or cross-validation.
Persist final evaluation metrics as machine-readable artifacts.
Add automated tests for preprocessing and model outputs.
Add confidence intervals or repeated-split analysis for more robust comparisons.
